recognize_zh: CSF 細胞離心抹片可見一群中大型異常淋巴細胞，核深度凹陷、摺疊或切痕，染色質細緻、可見小核仁，胞質淡藍，數量與異型性都不是反應性淋巴球，符合被套細胞淋巴瘤（常為母細胞樣／多形性型）中樞神經侵犯。
features: Monotonous population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells (cytospin flattening accentuates size)
Irregular, deeply indented, cleaved to folded nuclear contours
Finely dispersed to slightly vesicular chromatin with small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale blue agranular cytoplasm with occasional blebs
Clean background without accompanying neutrophils or monocytes
describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows a cellular specimen composed of a monotonous population of medium- to large-sized atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have irregular, cleaved to folded nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale agranular cytoplasm. Reactive small lymphocytes, monocytes and neutrophils are not prominent. In a patient with mantle cell lymphoma, findings are consistent with leptomeningeal involvement, likely with blastoid or pleomorphic cytology; flow cytometry confirming a CD5-positive, light chain restricted B-cell population supports the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive CSF contains a mixed population of small lymphocytes, activated forms and monocytes with polytypic B cells, rather than a monotonous cleaved-cell population.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and very fine chromatin and are TdT-positive, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1-positive.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in CSF
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells may look similar but are cyclin D1-negative and usually CD5-negative, so immunophenotyping is required.
